title: Connect Two Scenes · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Connect Two Scenes · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Agree on two harmless scenes, such as finding a key and opening a box. The lead tells a short story that connects the scenes in the given order. The story includes both scenes in order with a clear connection. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Connect Two Scenes, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The story includes both scenes in order with a clear connection.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The story includes both scenes in order with a clear connection.
